subject: Re: QuantMed PO authorization, velocity discount and invoice cadence
messages:
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@quantmed.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@quantmed.com, contracts@quantmed.com
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: PO header & billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Ben/Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed by the latency profiles and the packaging options. Procurement needs to lock a few things before we can route a PO to AP:

1) PO header must include our Billing Entity ID (QMED-ENT-77) and the internal BU code (CARDIO-PLAT).
2) We need net45 terms by default; however, if Redwood can accept net30 and provide a 1.5% early-payment rebate, we can expedite approval (we've done this before).
3) Our AP team requires consolidated monthly statements rather than weekly invoices — can you accommodate a single monthly invoice with line-level detail?
4) We want the velocity discounts stated in the MSA to be applied as usage tiers on the invoice (we'll supply forecasted monthly tiers). If you need a separate schedule for this, please send an outline.

Also attaching our standard PO template (see attachment). Please advise if Redwood needs any special PO fields or attachment identifiers to reconcile.

Goal: get a signed PO in the next 10 business days so we can kick off onboarding the week of Sep 27.

Appreciate quick confirmation of the three items above.

Thanks,
Hannah Li
Head of Procurement | QuantMed Inc.
H: +1 415-555-0139

Attachment: QuantMed_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@quantmed.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO header & billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Hannah — great to hear and thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and next steps.

1) PO header fields: we can accept Billing Entity ID and BU code. I'll attach a PO_Header_Template.xlsx with the exact header keys our finance system uses (so AP can populate fields that map straight into our ERP).

2) Net terms / early-pay: Our standard enterprise offering is net45. We can make a one-time concession to net30 with a 1.5% early-pay rebate for the first 12 months tied to a minimum monthly commit (see velocity bullets below). Vanessa, can we confirm finance ok on the rebate structure?

3) Monthly consolidated invoice: Yes — we can produce a single monthly invoice with line-level usage. If QuantMed wants weekly statements for internal tracking, we can provide that as a non-billing report (PDF/CSV) while keeping invoicing monthly.

4) Velocity discounts: we typically express these as a separate discount schedule (attached CSV) that maps usage tiers to unit-price multipliers. We'll need the forecasted monthly tiers you mentioned to pre-seed billing tiers for month 1. If you'd like, we can also bake the first-quarter estimate into the initial PO as a not-to-exceed credit.

Next steps: Vanessa and I will loop Marissa from Finance to finalize the rebate mechanics and finalize the PO header mapping. I'll send a redline of the SOW to align scope with the PO. If QuantMed can return the PO with the Billing Entity ID and BU code populated, we can accept it and queue for signature.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

Attachments: PO_Header_Template.xlsx (xlsx), Velocity_Discount_Table.csv (csv), Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@quantmed.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO header & billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Hannah — looping in Finance (Marissa) to confirm the rebate mechanics and one-off net30 concession. TL;DR: finance is minded to approve conditional rebate if QuantMed agrees to a monthly minimum commit for the first 90 days. Details below.

• Net30 + 1.5% early-pay rebate: Finance will approve provided there is a minimum monthly commit of $75k for the first three months. The rebate will be applied as a contra-line on the monthly invoice once payment clears.
• Velocity schedule: we can overlay a tiered unit-rate table (attached) that applies retroactively within the billing period — i.e., if you hit Tier 3 by month-end, the invoice will reflect Tier 3 pricing for usage that month. We'll cooperate on a reconciliation run for the first quarter.
• PO header: the PO_Header_Template.xlsx includes the exact field names our AR team requires (BillingEntityID, BUCode, ContractID, POReference). Please ensure the PO includes those exact keys to avoid remapping delays.
• Monthly invoice with weekly statements: accepted. We'll include a single invoice plus a weekly usage CSV to your AP inbox for internal tracking.

Marissa — can you confirm the invoice field we should use for the 'early-payment rebate' so contracts team can reference it in the SOW?

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@quantmed.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@quantmed.com, contracts@quantmed.com
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO header & billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Hannah — thanks for the patience. Finance has reviewed and here is the formal confirmation and a short checklist we need on the PO to route to signature:

Checklist for AP/PO:
- BillingEntityID: QMED-ENT-77 (exact match)
- BUCode: CARDIO-PLAT (exact match)
- POReference: free-form allowed, please avoid special characters except dashes and slashes
- ContractID: please reference Deal ID QMED-2026-048 so we can auto-link in our ERP

Terms confirmed:
- Invoice cadence: single monthly invoice (first invoice on Oct 31 covering Sep 27–Oct 31 ramp)
- Weekly usage statements: delivered as CSV to procurement@quantmed.com every Monday
- Net30 concession: approved for first 12 months only if QuantMed commits to a minimum monthly usage of $75,000 for first 90 days. Early-payment rebate of 1.5% will be applied as a credit on the invoice following cleared payment.
- Velocity discounts: Redwood will apply the attached Velocity_Discount_Table.csv as the canonical schedule. Any forecasted tiers QuantMed provides will be used to seed month-1 pricing; final reconciliation will occur at quarter-end.

If QuantMed can return the populated PO by Sep 21 with the checklist items, we will countersign the SOW and generate the DocuSign packet for signatures. I've attached a short redline to the SOW indicating the rebate mechanics and where the ContractID goes.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you'd like to walk the AP team through the fields — propose Tue Sep 15 at 11am PT.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v2_redline.pdf (pdf), Velocity_Discount_Table.csv (csv), PO_Header_Template.xlsx (xlsx)
